context: Ren interviews a coach on training.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: sports interview; vocabulary (去年/かける/させる/正しく/伴う) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 去年から、選手は伸びましたか?
lines.en: Have the players improved since last year?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 去年より、ぐっと伸びたで。
lines.en: They've grown a lot since last year.
lines.style: lively Kansai coach voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 練習に、時間をかけたんですか?
lines.en: Did you put time into training?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 基本を、正しく身につけさせたんや。
lines.en: I had them learn the basics correctly.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai coach voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 上達には、努力が伴いますね。
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そや、痛みも伴うけどな。
lines.en: Right, though pain comes with it too.
lines.style: warm Kansai coach voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正しい姿勢を、保たせるんですね。
lines.en: You have them keep correct form.
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 時間かけて、正しく教えるのが一番や。
lines.en: Taking time to teach correctly is best.
lines.style: warm Kansai coach voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
